Daily US-Israel-Iran War Brief:
11th Aug 2026:

- We will be posting daily war updates on the ongoing war in Middle East
- ⁠Follow us for daily Brief

● A commercial cargo ship was attacked by Yemen’s Iran-aligned Houthi forces in Bab el-Mandeb Strait, killing 3 crew members.

● Qatar’s Foreign Ministry Spokesperson said that negotiations between Oman and Iran have reached an advanced stage.

● Iran’s FM Araghchi met Pakistani Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi in Tehran, hours after Pakistan's defense minister said the US and Iran are close to “some sort of an arrangement.”

● US Energy Secretary said oil flows from the Gulf have climbed to about 15 million barrels per day, with more than 20 million barrels exported Sunday.

● Qatar publicly accused PM Netanyahu of deliberate "foot-dragging" on a ceasefire after Israel rejected the US-backed 15-point Gaza "Board of Peace" roadmap.

- We will be posting daily war updates on the ongoing war in Middle East
- ⁠Follow us for daily Brief
